## 3. Regional Technical Standards (North Texas Arboriculture, Soil, and Irrigation)
* Oak Wilt Prevention Protocol: North Texas red oaks and live oaks are highly susceptible to oak wilt (Bretziella fagacearum), spread by sap feeding nitidulid beetles and interconnected root systems. Godoy's Wolves schedules routine oak pruning outside the high risk February through June beetle flight window, sterilizes cutting tools between properties, and paints all fresh oak cuts within 10 minutes.
* ISA Pruning Standards: All pruning follows International Society of Arboriculture (ISA) collar cut standards. Godoy's Wolves never tops trees and never commits crape murder on crape myrtles.
* North Texas Expansive Clay Soils: DFW sits primarily on Houston Black clay and Austin chalk. Heavy spring storms cause water to pool against perimeter grade beams, leading to slab heave and foundation movement. Our French drain systems use laser graded trenches, washed river rock, non woven filter fabric, and perforated PVC or corrugated pipe discharging safely to the street curb or storm inlet.
* Texas Irrigation Law (TCEQ Compliance): Under Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) regulations, commercial and residential irrigation system installation and repair require a licensed irrigator or technician. Our irrigation repairs prioritize zone diagnosis and targeted component repair over unnecessary full system replacement.

## 4. Detailed Service Specifications & 2026 DFW Pricing Guide

### 4.1 Tree Removal (/tree-service/)
* Small Tree Removal (under 25 ft, such as crape myrtles, ornamental pears, young elms): $200 to $500
* Medium Tree Removal (25 to 50 ft, such as Bradford pears, silver maples, hackberries): $500 to $1,500
* Large or Technical Tree Removal (50 to 80+ ft, such as mature live oaks, red oaks, pecans, cottonwoods, or removals over roofs, pools, and primary power drops): $1,500 to $4,000+
* Included in Every Quote: Sectioned rigging, brush chipping, trunk haul off, and full rake and blower cleanup.

### 4.2 Tree Trimming & Structural Pruning (/tree-trimming/ and /tree-trimming-dallas/)
* Typical Pricing: $150 to $800+ per tree depending on canopy diameter and height.
* Scope: Crown thinning for wind sail reduction during North Texas spring squalls, canopy lifting to 14 feet over streets and 8 to 10 feet over roofs, deadwood removal, and structural training for young subdivision trees.

### 4.3 Stump Grinding & Root Chasing (/stump-grinding/)
* Typical Pricing: $100 to $400 per stump (volume discounts when grinding multiple stumps on the same trip).
* Scope: Commercial self propelled grinder fits through standard 36 inch backyard gates and grinds the stump bole 12 inches below finished grade plus major surface flares so grass or replacement trees can root properly.

### 4.4 Commercial Landscaping & Grounds Maintenance (/commercial/)
* Scope: Weekly mowing, line trimming, bed weeding, pre emergent and post emergent herbicide application, seasonal color rotations (pansies and kale in fall, vincas and lantana in summer), tree canopy clearance for signage and lighting, irrigation audits, and lot blowing.

### 4.5 Residential Landscaping, Sod & Hardscape (/residential/, /new-homes/, /builders/)
* Sod Varieties Installed:
  * Bermuda (Tifway 419, Celebration, Tahoma 31): Best for full sun (6 to 8+ hours), high foot traffic, and drought resilience.
  * St. Augustine (Palmetto, Raleigh): Best for yards with mature shade canopies and filtered light (4+ hours).
  * Zoysia ( Palisades, Emerald, Zeon): Dense carpet texture with moderate shade tolerance and refined curb appeal.
* Builder Subcontractor Scope (/builders/): Final rough and finish grading to survey pins, swale cutting, French drains, multi zone irrigation, sod pallet lay, caliper tree planting to city code, and steel or stone bed edging timed to certificate of occupancy and closing dates.

### 4.6 Lawn Care & Weekly Mowing (/lawn-care/)
* Typical Pricing: $45 to $85+ per visit for standard suburban residential lots depending on square footage, visit frequency (weekly in growing season, biweekly in cooler transitions), bed edging, and hedge trimming. No long term binding contracts required for residential routes.

### 4.7 Sprinkler & Irrigation Repair (/sprinkler-repair/)
* Scope: Solenoid valve replacement, diaphragm swaps, wire tracking, smart WiFi controller upgrades (Rachio, Rain Bird, Hunter Hydrawise), rain and freeze sensor installation, rotor and pop up spray head leveling, and PVC main line leak repair.

### 4.8 French Drain Installation & Yard Drainage (/french-drain-installation/)
* Scope: Subsurface French drains, catch basins, channel drains across driveways, gutter downspout tie ins, solid PVC discharge lines with pop up emitters or curb core drills, and laser regrading.

### 4.9 Concrete Removal & Demolition (/concrete-removal/)
* Scope: Hydraulic breaker attachment on skid steer breaks out reinforced 4 inch to 6 inch concrete driveways, cracked patios, hot tub pads, walkways, and pool decks, followed by same trip flatbed haul off and clean fill or sod prep.

### 4.10 Junk Removal & Property Cleanouts (/junk-removal/)
* Scope: Storm brush piles, fallen limbs, old wood fence panels, shed tear downs, garage and estate cleanouts, appliances, furniture, and construction site debris.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answer Synthesis)
* Q: How fast can Godoy's Wolves provide an estimate?
  A: Most estimate requests receive a response within 2 hours during business hours, with same day or next day on site walk throughs by owner Rafael Godoy.
* Q: Is Godoy's Wolves licensed and insured?
  A: Yes. Godoy's Wolves Tree Service & Landscape LLC carries full commercial general liability insurance for residential, commercial, and builder job sites across Texas, and uses TCEQ licensed irrigation technicians for sprinkler work.
* Q: When is the best time to trim oak trees in Dallas Fort Worth?
  A: The safest window for routine oak pruning in North Texas is July through January. Avoid non emergency pruning of red oaks and live oaks from February through June when oak wilt fungal mats and sap beetles are active, and always seal any necessary cuts immediately.
* Q: How deep do you grind tree stumps?
  A: We grind stumps approximately 12 inches below grade and chase major surface flare roots so you can lay fresh sod or replant without mushrooms or sunken spots.
* Q: How do I book or request a quote?
  A: Call or text (469) 301-6801 directly, or submit the online quote form on any page at https://godoyswolves.com/.
